label: Quantitative genetics
text: BI.O.A4.2 Quantitative genetics. Broad-sense heritability H² = V_G/V_P. Narrow-sense heritability h² = V_A/V_P. Both are variance ratios in a stated population and environment, not individual destinies. The breeder's equation R = h²S holds for a trait under truncation-like selection, with additive effects and no genotype–environment covariance. Human heritability estimates are owned here; MS.O.A3 cites them.

warrant.standard: Variance-component estimate with stated design and population
